adapter_configuration.note: Served model tag is the configured LoRA-named tag; API metadata does not independently prove whether PEFT weights are merged into the served GGUF.

context_regimes.pass_a: Top five reranked Phase 4 contexts, cross-encoder rank order.
context_regimes.pass_b: Exact adjudicated indexed text for clean benchmark ground_truth_chunk_ids.

metrics.token_f1: Multiset token overlap F1 with \w+ lowercase tokens.
metrics.semantic_similarity: Cosine similarity of normalized all-MiniLM-L6-v2 answer/reference embeddings.
metrics.citation_compliance: Binary: at least one citation marker exactly matches a chunk ID in the supplied context.
metrics.citation_grounding_rate: Valid supplied-context citation markers divided by all citation markers; zero if no markers.
metrics.evidence_token_grounding_rate: Distinct generated answer tokens present in supplied evidence; lexical proxy, not entailment.

refusal_scoring: Keyword/phrase detector; label denotes approved refusal-test candidate only, not independently verified corpus-wide absence.
d0_claim_restriction: D0 is a Validation-Derived Diagnostic Baseline, not an independent test set.
